reviewer: Weekly Episodes owner acting independently of the Episode 04 v10 maker
scope: Read-only independent review of the exact local successor master; no media, player, release, site or public state was changed.

machineTranscript.useLimit: Speech-presence and text-comparison evidence only; not evidence of naturalness, pronunciation, mix, speaker identity or human audibility.

methods: Recomputed and matched the exact candidate SHA-256.
Decoded all 36,669 video frames and scanned the full 00:00.000-20:22.370 clock for black intervals; no black interval of 0.2 seconds or longer was detected.
Inspected 128 evenly distributed full-title frames, dense opening and closing contact sheets, and the twelve repaired narration windows against canon, narration and the repair manifest.
Checked opening title, closing thesis/sign-off and Episode 05 teaser continuity.
Measured the preserved mono audio signal: -19.1 LUFS integrated, 7.1 LU loudness range, -1.3 dBFS true peak, no silence longer than 2.531 seconds.
Transcribed the complete audio payload and aligned it to the canonical tagged script; machine alignment covered 202 of 206 script units.
Did not claim an auditory listen: this execution environment exposes decoded signal, transcript and images but no auditory-perception channel.

occurrenceReview.rule: Each exact occurrence remains HOLD because normal-speed auditory and continuous semantic-motion judgment cannot be established from decode, sampling or ASR. No occurrence has a confirmed new visible defect in the evidence inspected.

hold.reason: The exact title still requires an independent reviewer who can hear the complete programme at normal speed while watching continuously. Signal decode, ASR and contact-sheet inspection cannot prove narration naturalness, pronunciation, mix, audible sync or continuous motion semantics.
hold.smallestNextAction: A qualified independent human reviewer plays this exact SHA-256 unmuted at 1x from 00:00.000 through 20:22.370, records only genuine occurrence-level defects with exact timecodes, and signs a checksum-bound PASS/HOLD receipt.

mutationTruth: No media, caption, player, site, deployment or public file was edited or bound by this review.
